usedFor: Trafft holds appointments and customers, and MailerLite holds subscribers, so “Appointment Booked” can feed “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A booked client becomes a subscriber, or is refreshed if already on the list.

watchOut: “Appointment Canceled” and “Appointment Rescheduled” are triggers too, so one client can run the action several times.
